title: Remove the compile-time-constant channel name
description: CHANNEL_NAME is a `const val`, which must be a compile-time constant — it can't hold the result of context.getString(). It's only used inside createNotificationChannel(context: Context), which already has a Context, so its usage site (next task) reads the resource directly instead. Uses change_type=modify with an empty exact_code (rather than change_type=delete) so the splice is deterministic — delete has no exact_code path and always requires the local model to correctly return an empty fragment, which qwen3:4b did not do reliably for this exact task.
acceptance_criteria: The 'private const val CHANNEL_NAME = "Goblin Loot Reminders"' line is removed
